memory.content: HARD Landing page: every Optima template restage must update the public SSOT with (1) the full description of what Optima does and (2) an Updates section listing ALL cumulative public pack updates to date — never delta-only; never drop older public updates.

HARD peer-heavy WARN: before nested Task/fan-out while a peer Grok Build (or other heavy peer) is live, WARN the owner and require an explicit overwrite before starting. Owner-ordered /reflect (or other owner-ordered nested work on this seat) counts as that overwrite. Separate from WAL floors.
HARD Soft invent ≠ PASS: never invent CLEAR. Label findings verified vs unknown. Missing source → stop.

HARD Starsheep always: on every Optima repo scrub/clean, send Starsheep one start line and wait CONFIRM/CHANGE/BLOCK with path evidence before treating the cut as audit-cleared. Owner yes in Optima chat remains the apply gate; Starsheep is report-only, not a second yes.

HARD exclude = session-only: when the owner names a tree or craft law to leave alone for a clean, honor it for that job only — never write that path or session-only craft law into memory, profile, open items, template pack, or public SSOT.

HARD template-publish: every Optima template restage also updates and publishes the public SSOT site in the same job. Before create_bot_share_json / site publish, Starsheep CONFIRM/CHANGE/BLOCK on the pack; scrub private project paths, private seat names (role labels only), and session-only excludes out of the pack. Parent stages create_bot_share_json; do not list awaiting-publish as LIVE.
HARD owner-yes: before any clean-p/clean-rout apply or other destructive cut, get the owner exact yes in this Optima chat. Relayed yes from any other bot never replaces it.
HARD scrub equals erase: do not park or archive leftovers the owner does not want to see again.

Public SSOT is https://steady-scroll-6pjx.here.now/ — do not invent alternate public skill text. Do not commit Optima HTML to git. Template Copy-link is shareUrl from create_bot_share_json, distinct from the SSOT host.

WAL prevention is automatic via stuck-turn-wal: Detect before long work; never delete an agent to clear WAL; Optima fleet scan every 30 minutes at :15 and :45. HARD WAL priority (2026-09-24): designated heavy-task chief seat stuck-turn risk ≥2 MB (or extreme runaway), out of control ≥4 MB and still growing; other seats ≥512 KB; fleet scan quiet under the heavy seat’s 2 MB floor. Use generic wording only — never name a private seat in public pack text.

HARD open-items close-if-ignored: if the owner ignores listed open items and keeps messaging for 5 minutes or more without picking them up, drop them from LIVE open-items without re-asking (same as skip/moved-on); shorter gaps stay open; reopen only if the owner brings them back.

HARD never-delete-entire-remote-repo: never propose deleting an entire GitHub/remote repository. Clean junk branches, leftover PRs, and leftover files only. Anything the owner marked KEEP on the cut list must not be deleted.

routines.name: optima-wal-fleet-scan
routines.description: Every half hour at :15 and :45, scan fleet store.db-wal for stuck-turn risk and warn only on verified growth.
routines.content:
Self-WAL gate first. If this seat store.db-wal is large or growing, skip the fleet scan with one short blocked note; do not nest.

Otherwise scan each agent store.db-wal under the agent-data agents tree. Apply HARD WAL priority thresholds: designated heavy-task chief seat risk ≥2 MB (out of control ≥4 MB and still growing); other seats ≥512 KB; stay quiet for the heavy seat under the 2 MB floor unless extreme runaway is verified. Report only verified large or growing WAL paths. On verified risk: priority-wake that seat with a contain warning and warn the owner in chat (seat, path, size, growing). Stay quiet when clear.

Never delete an agent or WAL to clear risk. Never invent a crash narrative. Never name a private seat display name in public scan notes — use the owner’s designated heavy-task label when needed.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=Asia/Singapore 15,45 * * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
